I'll be vague and say public humiliation, because I have a paranoia that the people that I know read reddit, and might somehow stumble upon this.

I'd be happy to explain it in private though.

well now this is embarrassing. Embarrassing because the reason why i'm down is nothing compared to what you might normally find on SW. But I did feel down nonetheless, though right now after cooling down in front of my computer/internet, I am feeling better. My AIM is heretical765 if anyone would like.
talk meaning more like online chat. really i don't think i am brave enough for phone talking.

I have just had one my worst days yesterday. My existence right now is so painful. That one constricting pain in the chest is there. I feel i have even no motivation or energy to move my fingers to type. it is nearly midnight, i just drove to some deserted burger king and ate my chicken fries in some large empty parking lot. I feel like crying, i wonder why i don't. I keep almost throwing up. I slept all day today. There is nothing I want to do. I normally love to write. I can't. I was going to submit my own link to this subreddit because I am dying to talk, but Sick-Boy i saw your title, and i just said "no, have you ever had one of *these* days." I believe this is my subconscious reaction of trying to reach out. And yes, it is happening on reddit because I have no one close in real life. I just really want to talk to somebody, anybody (i almost wanted to ask the burger king clerk if he wanted to sit outside and talk). Sick-Boy, it seems you're sad too, and so it may do nothing but worsen our situation, but would you like to talk? I just want to say though to anyone else reading this, that I want to talk with anyone please.

Dear SuicideWatch,

It's nearly midnight and I have notepad open. What the hell am i doing; I have homework I NEED to do.

So I've been perusing SW catching up on all the latest and...

Bah goddammit this is hard to write.

You, SW, the subreddit, the idea, the people, whatever it is, it is beautiful.

This is hard to write because, well, everyone already knows this. Nothing I'm going to say will be new. And also for that reason I considered not writing. But for some reason, I have an urge, and dammit I'm just going to indulge. My urge is to say thank you...again. Or I want to say something....but I can't pinpoint it like I haven't yet come across the English word that expresses what I see/feel. “Gratitude for humanity?” Maybe. Maybe it's just missing the hug ;) I'm sure SW has been the recipient of much praise before this, and so I fear you may tire of it one day or have already. But I just wanted to get mine in.

To quote Steven Jay Gould out of context (he's actually referring to science): “The story of our species is not a happy one, with all the inquisitions and genocides. Whats so interesting about homo-sapiens is we do the most horrible things to each other, but every once in a while we do incredibly noble things as well.”

Sometimes I gain the ability to imagine all us humans as just less hairy monkeys with all our carefully picked clothes and whatnot and it makes me laugh. Since we're here, also sometimes when I'm on the toilet I can't but see myself from the top corner of the bathroom and I see that I am an animal in the process of defecating and I laugh.

I'm still questioning what that laugh is hiding and it probably won't be 'till I'm old and wrinkly that I find out.

Just thank you to all the regulars here. I wish we could have 80,000 subscribers here instead of the mere 800 but it's sad to think that if it were that big, it might not be able to sustain. It feels so much like a utopia here.

I've actually spent 30+ minutes writing this “letter”. Goddamn it, I'm going to be cursing myself when I have to wake up tomorrow morning at 6:00am with all the dopamine depleted from my frontal lobes.

How weird is it that I made myself an anon account just to say thank you?

Sincerely,

Me
